items.description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Programs Manager to our Revenue team in Brazil ! This role is to join our global Revenue Growth function, responsible for owning and scaling Wellhub’s expansion agenda across our SMB client base and extending it up-market to larger accounts. As a senior individual contributor, you will run the program end-to-end—using data analysis, A/B experimentation, and monthly waves to drive incremental revenue while building agentic and automated workflows to eliminate manual execution. The position will work closely with SMB Commercial Leadership, Value Management, Sales Operations, and Commercial Finance to design next-generation growth levers and forecast financial impact. This is a great opportunity to own a high-impact global growth engine and take cutting-edge AI automation into production to bring our existing-client revenue to the next level. YOUR IMPACT Owns the scaled Revenue Growth strategy globally, in partnership with SMB Commercial Leadership, Value Management and Sales Operations, including end-to-end monthly execution: leverage SQL for cohort identification, price-increase, off-waiver and step-up-waiver waves, and tracking against budget and attainment. Defines where and how to expand the Programmatic Agenda up-market to larger clients, including which cohorts, levers and pricing guardrails fit those segments, in partnership with Value Management and Commercial Leadership. Designs and runs A/B experiments, with clear hypotheses and success metrics, to drive incremental growth or improve the operational efficiency of the Revenue Growth strategy. Leads the monthly and quarterly cross-functional Revenue Growth forums with commercial, operations and finance leadership, and independently delivers executive summaries of performance and program health to senior leadership. Drives financial impact analysis with Commercial Finance and Sales Operations so teams understand expected versus actual impact, and forecasts revenue growth from the existing client base. Drives and influences the development and prioritization of new programs with Product, Product Marketing, Client Marketing, CX/CRG, Value Management and Commercial teams, to grow incremental client revenue, improve net revenue margins, and improve client communication and operational efficiency. Builds agentic and automated workflows that automate meaningful parts of the program, evaluating where an agent should replace a manual process and where it should not; provides continuity on in-flight automation and takes it from prototype to production. Analyzes net margins across the SMB base. Owns results dashboards and the retention-guidelines discount calculator used by CS/CRG agents, keeping both aligned to Value Management's current guidance. Scales proven GTM motions globally, supporting Global Programs and the Commercial and Channel Partner teams by sharing learnings and providing operational guidance. Determines the incremental and future development of the Client Console, partnering with Product Development and Analytics to prioritize the features needed to manage Wellhub clients at scale. Analyzes large datasets (SQL) to track program performance (NRR, renewal rate, MRR churn at renewal), and communicates findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE A strategic, data-driven professional with proven experience in pricing, revenue operations, growth strategy, or program management, with a proven track record of scaling commercial initiatives. You have extensive experience in SQL and large-dataset analysis, paired with solid in-depth knowledge of Salesforce and BI tools (such as Looker Studio) to build dashboards and track core metrics like NRR, renewal rates, MRR churn, and net margins. An analytical problem-solver with a deep understanding of pricing and renewal mechanics, capable of designing rigorous A/B experiments and partnering with Finance to forecast revenue impact against actuals. You are curious about and hands-on with AI and workflow automation, bringing the ability to take agentic workflows from prototype to production—while exercising sharp judgment on where automation should replace manual work and where human nuance is essential. A true self-starter who thrives on end-to-end ownership, seamlessly collaborating with and influencing cross-functional stakeholders across Commercial Leadership, Product, Marketing, Finance, and CX to turn complex ideas into global motions. A strong communicator, both written and verbal, with the ability to lead monthly and quarterly business forums, deliver clear executive summaries to senior leadership, and translate technical insights for non-technical audiences. You bring fluency in both English and Portuguese, allowing you to navigate global programs and local operations effortlessly. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that proven experience in pricing, revenue operations, or analytical program management, hands-on proficiency in SQL, and fluency in English and Portuguese are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs! Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday! PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025! This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here. Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos. #LI-REMOTE

items.description: " Appetiser challenges me to give the best version of myself. I like how the company is transparent about its business model and anyone can contribute with an idea for its improvement. The culture within the team is unique and everyone is talented and skillful in their profession. We set goals guided by virtues created by the team rather than the traditional core values. ” - Jeff Miralles / iOS Developer Are you someone who is DRIVING themselves to peak performance? Are you excited by HELPING PEOPLE create technology that impacts millions every day? If you answered YES to these questions, you may be a fit for Appetiser Apps . Join a high-performance team who are striving to go from an Australian market leader to a worldwide phenomenon. Our competitors cannot keep up with our technology, pace, and track record of successful clients. We need ambitious people like YOU to help us grow by 10X over the next 5 years. YOU WILL: BUILD beautiful websites using HTML and CSS to bring creative ideas to life. COLLABORATE with designers and developers to create web apps and backend mobile solutions. COORDINATE with teams to launch content, setting clear timelines and expectations. PLAN for the unexpected by preparing backup solutions to ensure site reliability. GROW and maintain the website by expanding its features and keeping content fresh. LEAD projects and, when needed, take charge of a team from start to finish. ADAPT quickly and take on new tasks as they arise. Requirements ​​The right fit for this role is DETERMINED, CURIOUS and EAGER TO GROW with : Has at least 1 year of post-graduate working experience Has a strong work ethic and takes ownership of their learning Is hungry to improve every day and open to feedback Understands core programming fundamentals and is excited to build real-world applications Has built mobile projects (school, internship, freelance, bootcamp, or personal apps) Preferably less than 30 years old BONUS : Experience in Agentic AI Frontend/Backend Basic understanding of Git for version control Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code Basic knowledge of unit testing principles Understanding of how APIs work (REST fundamentals) Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum or Kanban) Stable internet connection (minimum 30 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload ) Own laptop/desktop capable of handling development work Backend: Nice to have: Experience building projects using any modern backend framework (e.g., PHP/Laravel or similar architecture) Understanding of databases and basic SQL schema design Knowledge of clean coding principles (e.g., SOLID fundamentals ) Basic understanding of RESTful API design and testing (e.g., Postman, Insomnia, or similar tools) Exposure to deployment processes or cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar) is a plus Frontend: Comfortable with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, Vuejs Experience working with any modern frontend framework/library Understanding of responsive design and reusable component architecture Exposure to testing tools or static typing (e.g., TypeScript) is a bonus Join our team! Flexible Work Arrangements: The ability to work from anywhere in the world as long as you perform. Accelerate Your Career: After your probation period, you’ll receive regular performance and salary reviews every 6 months, giving you clear opportunities to advance based on your impact, growth, and contributions. Fast-Track Junior Progression: Every 4 months, you’ll have the opportunity for a performance and compensation review, ensuring your hard work and improvement are recognized early and often. Your career progression is merit-based; the more you learn, take initiative, and consistently deliver quality work, the faster you can level up. Become Your Best: Set personal & professional goals every quarter with your talent coach. Get optional counselling along the way. Global Impact: Build products that reach users worldwide and truly make a difference in the world! Public Recognition: Track your achievements as you build a personalportfolio & track record. Join a Culture of Drivers : Become part of a team that’s striving to be their very best. Monthly salary ranges from AUD 420–600 , depending on hiring region, experience, and local market benchmarks. If this resonates with you, please apply today. P.S. We're hiring multiple individuals. If you want to recommend someone, please email us; an attractive referral bonus awaits! P.P.S. If you have any questions, email us at Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: NYC, Remote Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. What’s the opportunity? The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Intercom uses data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data - both big and small - to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. We’re now seeing strong demand for data scientists who can apply their expertise directly with our most strategic customers. As a Forward Deployed Data Scientist, you’ll embed with customers to build Enterprise-grade Fin deployments. You’ll play a pivotal role in transforming how our most strategic customers scale customer support — working closely with them and our go-to-market teams to design, build, and implement data-driven solutions that unlock measurable impact. You’ll also feed insights from these frontline deployments back into Intercom’s product and strategy — helping shape the future of AI customer service. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, is energized by solving complex, real-world problems with data, and is motivated by seeing their work translate into both customer impact and product evolution. What will I be doing? Drive the adoption of Fin by helping customers automate and scale their support operations. Embed with strategic customers to understand their support workflows, data, and business challenges — to identify and implement opportunities where AI can deliver measurable impact. Steer customers toward best practices in measurement and AI adoption to realize the full value of Fin. Partner closely with Sales, Success, and Product to deliver seamless customer experiences and successful deployments, and to create feedback loops that shape product development. Use AI to prototype, test, and scale data-driven solutions, building tools that make us faster and more effective in driving Fin adoption and customer impact. What skills do I need? Proven ability to apply data science in real-world business contexts to drive measurable outcomes. Strong collaboration mindset; skilled at working across Sales, Success, Product, and Engineering. High adaptability and ownership: able to shift between deep technical analysis and high-level strategic framing. Excellent communication skills, both technical and non-technical. Rapid prototyping with systems thinking: you know when a customer needs a fast, bespoke answer, and when to build something others will keep using. Excellent SQL and production-aware Python, you write code other people can run, not just code that runs once and are experienced applying analytical and statistical methods to real business problems. Experience with AI/ML evaluation, LLM-driven applications, or conversational AI. Willing to travel and work on-site with customers to build deep relationships and uncover insights firsthand. Bonus skills and attributes Experience in technical consulting, customer-facing analytics, or SaaS product data science. Experience reframing the problem, not just solving it, you've spotted when the question you were handed wasn't the right one, and changed what got worked on. Experience applying AI to scale the data science workflow. *Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required. The base salary range for candidates within the New York Area is $206,000- $229,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). #LI-Hybrid Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers . Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Policies Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week. We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values . Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fin-senior-forward-deployed-data-scientist

Reach out and we'll match you. We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire. items.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
items.summary: Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.Â We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal â not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging. About the Role Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most. Your Area of Focus Â Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team. Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over. Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins. Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools. Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support. Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check. Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections. Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards. Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira. Your Professional Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production. SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets. Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams. Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt. Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems. Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation. Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision. Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills. Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred. Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred. Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred. Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred. Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus. Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred. #LI-SS1 #LI-Remote We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions. Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this: Zone 1: National Average Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions Zone 3: High-Cost Regions Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen. Zone 1 (National Average) $127,000 â $145,000 USD Â About Tebra Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing â so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout â helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more atÂ www.tebra.com . Our Values Start with the CustomerÂ We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens. Keep It Simple Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone. Stay EntrepreneurialÂ We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action. Better Together We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. Celebrate Success Life is short and joy is underrated. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/sx6tzFKwyUTPcquYzQkRFu/jobs-at-movement-labs Movement Labs is an incubator and consulting firm that uses technology, data, and experimentation to stop fascism and build progressive power. We help progressives win and defeat MAGA extremists through year-round work grounded in research and real-world testing. Our team partners with leading advocacy groups, grassroots organizers, and electoral campaigns to develop innovative tactics, win elections, and shift power for the long term. As the R&D powerhouse for the progressive movement, we’ve run over 100 randomized control trials (RCTs) on voter behavior and helped hundreds of organizations increase their impact. We work hard, and the environment evolves rapidly. We are adaptable, nimble, and shift quickly as needed to meet the moment. We are looking for candidates that thrive in this type of environment. We are looking for 2 roles, Senior and Mid-level Data Engineers to join the Tech department. You will be a part of an 8-person data engineering team, and will have a lot of ownership and ability to make an impact. You’ll work cross-functionally in a collaborative, startup-like environment. What the work looks like for our data team: Design and implement scalable data architecture for targeting and engagement Serve as technical partner to program teams Extend our foundational datasets to facilitate new outreach strategies Load-test our systems to prepare for elections Maintain key datasets for polling images and precinct cross-matching Develop standardized experimental frameworks for testing campaign effectiveness Build AI tooling that makes our own team faster — QC agents for data deliveries, the evals to trust them, and context systems that keep our repos self-documenting Our data team’s work mixes greenfield builds, pragmatic plumbing, incident response, and operational work. The relative mix shifts with the political calendar. This role is fully remote. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. Responsibilities Shape the pipelines and integrations feeding our RCT platform and our foundational voter datasets: the APIs, replication, federation layers, experiment randomization, and the failure modes that come with running data systems for hundreds of partner organizations on a non-negotiable political calendar Extend our data platform and orchestration layer, and optimize it for cost, runtime, and reliability so it holds up during the elections, with millions of outreach attempts Lead projects that span multiple systems and teams — scoping, designing, and driving them to real milestones Hold the bar on quality — test and validate your own work, review teammates' code, and mentor through that review Document and communicate — make your systems understandable to teammates, stakeholders, and non-engineers Rotate through on-call and rapid response, including evenings and weekends during high-stakes moments like election cycles Passionate about progressive politics and leveraging data, technology, organizing and research to build political power 3-6+ years of experience (Senior or Mid-level) in designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and integrations Strong proficiency in SQL and Python Experience building production software across a modern data stack — cloud data warehouses (BigQuery or similar), a transformation framework like dbt, and an orchestrator like Dagster or Airflow A track record of leading technical work across multiple systems or teams, and scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end Sound judgment about when to refactor, when to ship pragmatically, and how to leave systems better than you found them Strong written communication — you document what you build and can explain complex systems to non-engineers Genuine commitment to the mission of stopping fascism and building progressive power, and comfort operating on a political calendar Nice to Have: Experience in the progressive, political, advocacy, or nonprofit sector — including awareness of c3/c4/PAC boundaries and the sensitivities of political and voter data Familiarity with election results, voter file data, and the tools campaigns use to organize, text, and contact voters Experience on Google Cloud Platform Experience in on-call rotations and mentoring less-experienced engineers We’re looking for candidates with a wide range of skills and experience. If you’re excited about the job, even if you don’t match all the characteristics, we encourage you to apply. Base salary of $90,000-$150,000 Excellent health, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k) matching, and unlimited Paid Time Off Remote first culture with teammates all around the country. This position has an initial term of six (6) months beginning on the employee's start date. We love to keep top performers if possible. Applications may be reviewed earlier on a rolling basis so it benefits candidates to apply as soon as possible. The application process includes a phone screen, an exercise, and a full interview with the hiring manager. Due to the nature of our work, the process is moving quickly, and we hope candidates will start as soon as possible. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States. We are not able to provide sponsorship at this time. Movement Labs is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. If you require accommodations as part of the hiring process, please contact careers@movementlabs.com. Applications are reviewed by our hiring team—not automated systems. Our hiring process may include AI-assisted analysis of candidate materials, however, hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/movement-labs-senior-data-engineers

ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.clickguard.com/ We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next. Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers. Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency. What You'll Own HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced. The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery. You're a Fit If You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust. You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created. You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing You're Not a Fit If Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation Required Skills & Experience 3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved. CRM Architecture: Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses. Data Ownership: You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number. AI-Native Execution: You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work. Full-Funnel Accountability: You measure your work through the full chain from signup → trial → qualified account → paid → renewal → expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping. Cross-Team Range: Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow. Technical Proficiency HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API. SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data. Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, failed payments, and how each one shows up in MRR. Enrichment & Data APIs: Clay or equivalent, people and company data providers, and comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly. Automation Engineering: Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, or native AI-agent integrations) and AI coding tools (Claude Code or Codex), connecting the stack without engineering support. Logistics Remote, async-first team culture. Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between 7 AM and 2 PM EST . Full-time, long-term position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager

Then you'll show the world how to do it well through demos, docs, blog posts, videos, and conferences. This is a hands-on role combining engineering, content creation, and a strong public voice. You'll work closely with the teams that build our MCP server, CLI, API and docs. The landscape of how developers work with AI changes fast. You'll have the opportunity to move quickly, experiment, and take the lead on the future of AI use with databases and infrastructure. Make PlanetScale great with AI tools Build and maintain the plugins for PlanetScale in every AI marketplace and directory: agent plugins, skill registries, MCP directories, IDE extension stores and AI app builders Own our integrations with AI coding tools, agent frameworks and platforms Stay current with AI tools as they launch and ensure our customers have a great experience from day one Test the PlanetScale MCP server and CLI across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and other clients, and catch regressions before users do Find friction in creating a database, connecting, running migrations and debugging queries from inside an agent, then fix it or drive the fix with the owning team Improve the context agents rely on: tool descriptions, skills, llms.txt, docs written for agents, and error messages agents can act on Attention to AEO (answer engine optimization): make sure agents find and recommend PlanetScale Build and maintain skills for working with Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, improvement Track how often AI assistants and agents recommend PlanetScale for database questions, and whether what they say about us is accurate Instrument and report on agent usage: databases created by agents, time to first connection, MCP versus CLI usage, and where sessions fail Show people how to do it well Build demos and sample apps that show PlanetScale and AI tooling at their best Write docs, guides and blog posts on using databases effectively with AI, including safe access, branching and performance assessment Make videos and attend conferences to communicate with our audience how to build effectively with AI These attributes best describe you Daily use of AI coding agents, with strong opinions about what makes a tool work well with them Experience building an MCP server, plugin, CLI or SDK that real developers use Software engineering background in languages like TypeScript and Go, and comfort with APIs, OAuth and the command line Experience with writing docs, blogs, and / or video content creation Good at communicating with a broad audience and customers alike on socials Experience working with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite), schema design, migrations, connection handling, and Postgres or MySQL in production Data fluency: designing evals, writing the queries behind a dashboard, and telling a real trend from noise Clear communication of technical ideas in writing, on video and on stage Independence and speed: spotting a gap, shipping a fix, and telling people about it Genuine curiosity about the AI tooling landscape and a habit of keeping up with it Bonus points Contributions to the MCP spec, SDKs or popular open-source MCP servers Experience writing agent skills, plugins or rules files for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex Experience with LLM eval tools and building benchmarks for agents Experience with AEO or GEO, or with tracking how LLMs surface and recommend a product A blog, YouTube channel or GitHub that developers already follow Experience with Vitess, database sharding, or running databases at scale Why PlanetScale We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America. At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate! Total Compensation and Pay Transparency An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process. Base Salary Range: $170,000 - $220,000 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-ai-developer-experience-engineer

items.description: Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide. Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 ! We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm. Role Description We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to support our recruiting team as we scale the organization. In this 6-month contract, you’ll be owning interview logistics, keeping candidates informed, and helping us deliver a best-in-class candidate experience across technical and non-technical roles. This is a great opportunity for someone with coordination experience who wants to deepen their recruiting skills in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. Contract Details Duration: 6 months with possibility to extend Schedule: 40 hr. work week Location: ideally based in San Francisco, CA or New York City, NY What You’ll Learn You will learn how to run end-to-end recruiting coordination for a high-growth startup & across multiple teams. You will get experience partnering with recruiters and hiring managers across multiple functions. You will learn foundational sourcing skills, including building top-of-funnel pipelines and using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter and Covey. You will observe how to track and analyze core recruiting metrics (pipeline health, conversion rates, time-to-hire). You will develop best practices for maintaining clean ATS data and creating simple reports/dashboards. You will be able to deliver a best-in-class candidate experience through clear communication and strong logistics. Responsibilities Assist recruitment team by coordinating and scheduling interviews throughout all stages of the interview process, ensuring a positive and professional interaction for potential hires. Assist with additional scheduling of internal team meetings, candidate debriefs, and others as needed. Act as the ATS administrator in Ashby handling all system management, own LinkedIn admin and other recruiting tools, and oversee all Notion database management and maintenance. Package a weekly Recruiting progress report for the Executive leadership team. Partner cross-functionally to identify areas for improvement within recruitment activities to continuously improve process. Serve as the main point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, answering questions, providing timely updates, and setting clear expectations to deliver a warm, professional, first-class experience with Phantom. Help maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate data in our ATS. Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements and keep interview processes moving smoothly. Proactively flag bottlenecks and help unblock processes so candidates move efficiently through the funnel. Support occasional recruiting events. Qualifications At least 1 year of coordination experience (e.g. recruiting coordination, office coordination, executive assistant, operations, or similar role with heavy scheduling/logistics). Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent). Preference to work out of our San Francisco or NY office at least 2 days per week if local to those areas. Strong organizational and time-management skills; comfortable juggling multiple requests and changing priorities. Clear, professional written and verbal communication with candidates and internal stakeholders. Comfort working with tools like Google Workspace & Notion. Must be highly organized, efficient and process driven. Excellent at anticipating needs and creating structure out of ambiguity. Exceptional critical thinker who can tackle complex problems, is quick to respond and has a high attention to detail with little to no error. Nice to Have Experience working in a startup or high-growth tech company. Hands-on experience with an ATS such as Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby. Prior exposure to technical recruiting (engineering, product, data) or university recruiting. Genuine curiosity about crypto, blockchains, or web3 products. Why Work With Us Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people. Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world. Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless. Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation. Benefits ( only available to full-time employees) Competitive salary and equity Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!) 401(k) retirement plan Wellness stipend Weekly meal stipend Learning & Development stipend Remote / WFH set-up stipend We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career. By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

items.description: If you're the kind of marketer who'd rather be in Google Ads than in a meeting about Google Ads, read on. We have a full production team: content, design, web, video, product marketing. We have a sales team that wants more meetings and an SDR team that follows up fast. We have budget, and it's going up. What we don't have is the person who runs paid. Someone who builds the campaigns, reads the search terms, sets the bids, fixes the tracking, and turns the spend into booked demos. That's this role. It's hands-on by design. There's no agency and no paid media team behind you, because we'd rather give the budget to the person doing the work. You own the number, 30 booked demos a month, and you own how you get there. About three quarters of your week is advertising. The rest is trade media, syndication and other digital lead gen. We're looking for someone who's done this before, more than once, and has the numbers to show it. Read on! (this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying) _________________________________________________________________________________________ We are Shape.Construction! We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Watch our short film about it). We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 4 core values for a good life We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has: Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself Care about people – Your relationship with others around you Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version! We enshrined our values in our vision We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions: To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society _________________________________________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role Shape helps main contractors build a stronger change case from site records. Our buyers are project managers and commercial managers at main contractors in the UK, US and Europe. Most of them aren't searching for a product like ours, because they don't know the problem has a fix. Your job is to find them, get them to a demo, and hand them to sales in good shape. You own one number: 30 booked demos a month for the sales team. You own every digital lead generation activity that feeds it, and you run those activities yourself. Team You'll sit in Shape's marketing team and report to the Head of Marketing, who has a paid media background and has built most of our marketing automation in n8n and Claude. You'll work daily with the SDR team, who qualify and follow up what you generate, and the account executives who run the demos. Content, design, web, video and product marketing are covered by the team. You brief them for ad creative, landing pages and lead magnets. You don't write the copy or design the assets. You do build and run everything in the ad platforms and in HubSpot. You won't have an agency or a paid media team behind you. The budget goes into the channels, and you run them. You will have a Head of Marketing who's done this job, a production team to brief, and SDRs who want what you generate. How your time splits Full-funnel digital advertising 75% Google Search, LinkedIn, Meta and any other platform that works for B2B. Cold acquisition, retargeting, free app sign-ups, demo requests. You build it, run it, optimise it and report on it. Other digital lead generation 25% Trade media advertising, content syndication, review sites, partnerships and anything else that produces demos at an acceptable cost. You'll test, measure and scale or cut. Webinars sit alongside this. You'll promote them and fill the room through paid and the database. The programme itself is run by product marketing with speakers from sales. What a normal week looks like We work four-day weeks, Monday to Thursday. This is what yours would contain. Every day Log into Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Check spend, search terms, cost per lead, conversion volume. Add negatives, adjust bids and budgets, pause what isn't working. Review every new lead in HubSpot. Check it has a source, check it against the ICP, make sure it's reached an SDR. Chase any lead that's past the follow-up SLA. The SDRs are good, but you own the handoff until the demo is booked. Every week Launch or refresh at least one creative or landing page test. Update the cost per demo by channel dashboard and share it with the Head of Marketing and sales. A 30-minute sync with the SDR team on lead quality: what's converting, what isn't, and why. Brief content and design on what you need next. Every month Reallocate budget across channels based on cost per booked demo. Report on leads, demos booked, demos sat, cost per channel and what you're changing next month. Launch or review a trade media or syndication test. Promote any webinar the team is running. Every quarter Prepare and present the channel strategy for the next quarter, with the numbers to back it. Your first four weeks Tracking fixed. UTMs on everything, deal source mandatory in HubSpot, lifecycle stages agreed with the SDRs, conversions firing in Google and LinkedIn. Google Search and LinkedIn campaigns live and optimising. A first read on what each channel costs per booked demo. After that it's scaling what works and cutting what doesn't. Your Capabilities You are an operator. You've built and run B2B paid campaigns yourself, at more than one company, and you have the numbers to prove it. You think in cost per booked demo, not clicks. You'd rather bring a playbook you've already proven than experiment your way into one on our budget. You are an expert in Google Ads for B2B. Campaign and ad group structure, match types, negative keyword discipline, bid strategies and when to use each, conversion tracking, search term review, landing page alignment. LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Matched audiences and account lists, job title and company targeting, retargeting from website, video and engagement, lead gen forms versus landing pages, document and video ads, the Insight Tag. Retargeting across platforms including Meta, to warm audiences who already know us: website visitors, free app sign-ups, content downloaders, webinar registrants. Conversion tracking and attribution . UTMs, Google Tag Manager, offline conversion uploads, getting source data onto CRM records so every demo can be traced to a channel. HubSpot for marketing: forms, lifecycle stages, workflows, lead routing, reporting and the ads integration. Landing page conversion . What to test, how to read the results, when to call it. Reporting . Building a cost per demo by channel view that a Head of Marketing and a CEO can read without you explaining it. You will have (The fundamentals) Mastery: A repeatable B2B paid acquisition playbook you've run at more than one company, with numbers from both. Hands-on day to day in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager within the last 12 months. You personally built the campaigns, not a team, agency or specialist. You can state the largest monthly budget you've personally run, what a lead cost and what a booked meeting cost. Communication: Fluent written and spoken English. Able to brief a creative team clearly and to report honestly upward on what's working and what isn't, including what you'd stop. Leadership: You own a number and want to be measured on it. You work out why something isn't converting and fix the right problem. You lead yourself in a remote role without needing structure imposed on you. Impact: AI-native. You use AI (we run on Claude) for reporting, analysis and admin so your time goes on the accounts and the strategy. If you're still doing manually what an AI can do, this isn't the role for you. You will learn here (If you don't have it now you will after joining) Trade media advertising and content syndication in a niche B2B market, and how to make bought leads convert. Filling a webinar through paid and the database. A bonus if you've run webinars end to end. Construction and how main contractors buy. A bonus, not a requirement. n8n, for the automations that sit around your campaigns. What we'll ask you about So you can prepare, these are the things we'll want to talk through: The largest monthly ad budget you've personally managed, on which platforms, and what a lead and a booked meeting cost you. One B2B campaign you built yourself, from setting up the account to the meetings it produced, with the numbers at each stage. Who else worked on your campaigns in your last role, and what they did versus what you did. Which bid strategies you've used, in which situations, and why. How you set up conversion tracking and attribution yourself, and in which tools. At the second stage, a short exercise: the advertising plan you'd run to get us to 30 booked demos a month, presented back to us. Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true: You'd rather set the strategy and have someone else build the campaigns You'd rather report on activity than be measured on booked demos You want an easy role without much challenge You like to be the smartest person in the room You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team _________________________________________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions Is this really hands-on, or is "hands-on" just a word in the ad? It's really hands-on. You'll be in the platforms every working day, and that's the point. If you've been managing people who do this and you miss doing it yourself, this is the role. If you'd rather keep managing, it probably isn't. Can you tell me more about what the role is like? We are in scale up mode so it will be a full-on role with more things to do than time available. This is why it will be important to prioritise ruthlessly. The role is unusually clear about what success means, because it comes down to one number. That's a good thing if you like owning an outcome and having the autonomy to decide how you hit it. What does success look like? Within four weeks: tracking fixed, campaigns live, a first view of cost per demo by channel. Within three months: a predictable flow of demos landing with sales, with cost per booked demo visible for every channel, and a clear path to 30 a month. Beyond that: trade media and syndication contributing so we're not dependent on ad spend alone. What have you already got in place? Budget. A full production team for content, design, web and video. HubSpot as CRM and marketing platform, shared with sales. A free app with a two-month trial that already produces sign-ups. A hungry SDR team and account executives who want more inbound. A Head of Marketing who has done this job before and will work alongside you on strategy, while you run the execution. Where would I be working? All our roles are 100% remote and home-based. However, if you would like to work in a co-work space to get out of the house we may be able to arrange that. If you are in one of our locations with offices, you can come as often as you like. _________________________________________________________________________________________ Benefits The Standard Stuff Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft The Life-Changing Stuff In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being Flexibility : Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected. Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists. Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us _________________________________________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: Why do you want to join us? The largest monthly ad budget you have personally managed, on which platforms, and what a lead and a booked meeting cost One B2B paid campaign you built yourself, and the numbers it produced We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all letters will be read thoroughly. After that, we will reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. After that, we will schedule a couple of technical and personal assessments to understand what your level of capability is based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join you are starting at the right level of responsibility based on your capability not just based on experience. Compensation Additional Information

items.description: Intetics Inc. , a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Digital Project Manager to join our dynamic team on a part time basis. We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead digital and IT initiatives within a complex international environment, supporting large-scale technology programmes and collaborating with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries. We offer long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required (Germany). Minimum 5 years of proven experience managing digital transformation, IT, or technology-driven projects in structured enterprise environments. At least 5 years of experience in project financial management, including budget tracking, effort monitoring, deliverable validation, and cost control. At least 5 years of experience managing external vendors and service providers, including performance monitoring, deliverable acceptance, and contractual coordination. At least 5 years of hands-on experience with project management and collaboration tools, such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent enterprise platforms. Proven experience managing or coordinating multiple concurrent IT projects throughout the full project lifecycle. Solid understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches. Experience establishing and maintaining project governance, reporting structures, risk registers, project plans, and delivery documentation. Strong knowledge of project scope, schedule, budget, risk, issue, and dependency management. Experience working with enterprise IT solutions, applications, system integrations, APIs, and cloud-based platforms. Understanding of information security, data privacy, compliance requirements, and enterprise IT governance. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. Proven ability to work effectively in multicultural, geographically distributed, multi-vendor environments. Experience working with international organizations, multilateral institutions, intergovernmental bodies, or similarly complex global environments. Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, or equivalent. Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal. Responsibilities: Lead and manage digital and IT projects throughout the entire lifecycle, from initiation and planning to execution, monitoring, and closure. Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocations, and delivery milestones. Establish and maintain project governance processes, ensuring compliance with organizational standards, delivery methodologies, and quality requirements. Coordinate cross-functional teams, technical specialists, business stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery. Monitor project progress, financial performance, resource utilization, and vendor deliverables against agreed objectives. Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and changes, ensuring timely escalation and resolution. Facilitate project governance meetings, status reviews, stakeholder workshops, and decision-making sessions. Prepare and deliver regular project status reports, presentations, dashboards, and management updates. Manage vendor relationships, monitor service provider performance, validate deliverables, and support contract-related activities. Ensure project deliverables meet agreed business requirements, technical specifications, quality standards, and acceptance criteria. Collaborate with technical teams to manage system dependencies, integration requirements, and technical delivery challenges. Ensure adherence to information security, confidentiality, data protection, and compliance requirements. Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation using established project management and collaboration tools. Support effective communication and alignment across geographically distributed teams and stakeholders.
