items.summary: Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities! What do we do?💥 We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences. Check out our ‘About Us’ page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional. How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻 As the Delive
items.description: Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities! What do we do?💥 We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences. Check out our ‘About Us’ page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional. How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻 As the Delivery Practice Manager at Clariti, you will lead the strategic and operational delivery of customer projects within the Professional Services organization. You’ll be responsible for building and scaling delivery excellence, ensuring that every engagement drives measurable value for customers and aligns with Clariti’s business objectives. This role combines delivery leadership, practice development, and customer and partner relationship management. You’ll guide a team of consultants and/or engagement managers to deliver successful implementations while shaping methodologies, tools, and processes that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. You are a people-first leader with strong customer-facing acumen, operational rigor, and a track record of transforming Professional Services into a trusted partner function that accelerates customer outcomes and organizational growth. Delivery Leadership Lead the successful delivery of all customer implementation and service engagements for Tier 1 and Tier 2 customers, ensuring outcomes exceed expectations in quality, timeliness, and value realization. Oversee and guide partner-led and joint delivery efforts, ensuring seamless collaboration between Clariti and its delivery ecosystem. Establish and maintain delivery methodologies, governance frameworks, and best practices that ensure scalability, predictability, and repeatable success across all projects. Collaborate with Sales, Solution Engineering, and partners during pre-sales to assist in defining project scope, delivery models, and implementation strategies that align with customer objectives. Contribute to RFP responses and scoping efforts by providing delivery perspective, resource planning input, and realistic timelines to set achievable customer expectations. Manage key customer escalations and coordinate with internal and partner stakeholders to ensure timely, empathetic resolution and sustained customer confidence. Analyze and execute on strategic delivery initiatives, ensuring alignment with corporate goals and consistent communication of project priorities, value, and success metrics. Practice Development Build and continuously refine Clariti’s delivery framework, including playbooks, tools, and templates, to enable repeatable, high-quality engagements. Develop scalable delivery models that integrate partner capabilities and accelerate time-to-value for customers. Partner with cross-functional leaders to align delivery strategy with Clariti’s product roadmap, customer success goals, and business growth initiatives. Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction. Establish measurable success metrics (e.g., utilization, margin, NPS, on-time delivery) and track team and partner performance against goals. Capture and document lessons learned from customer projects to strengthen delivery methodology and partner enablement. Partner Management Own and nurture relationships within Clariti’s partner ecosystem, including delivery, integration, and system implementation partners, to ensure alignment with delivery standards and customer experience objectives. Engage partners early in the sales and solutioning process to support scoping, RFP responses, and proposal development. Oversee partner delivery performance, resource capacity, and quality assurance to maintain consistent, high-value outcomes. Collaborate with partner organizations on enablement, training, and certification to expand Clariti’s delivery reach and maintain alignment with evolving methodologies. Serve as the primary point of contact for partner engagement, ensuring open communication, mutual accountability, and continuous improvement across all delivery collaborations. Customer Engagement Act as a strategic advisor to customers, fostering trusted, long-term partnerships that drive adoption, expansion, and advocacy. Manage the overall services relationship among strategic customers, partners, and Clariti throughout transformations, from pre-sales through post-go-live. Represent Clariti in executive engagements to communicate value realization, delivery performance, and roadmap alignment. Ensure a consistent and transparent customer experience across all engagements, whether delivered directly or through partners. People Leadership Attract, onboard, and develop top talent across Clariti’s Professional Services organization. Provide ongoing coaching and mentorship to build delivery excellence and partner collaboration skills within the team. Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning across both internal and partner delivery teams. Champion inclusive leadership and diversity of thought in all aspects of people development and practice growth. What do you bring to the team? 🧠 Experience: 5+ years in Professional Services delivery, consulting, or implementation management within a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment. Leadership: 3+ years leading high-performing teams, scaling a practice & functional ownership, and managing customer-facing delivery operations P&L Ownership and Financial Acumen : demonstrated financial acumen and a track-record with managing and leading P&L with accountability for revenue, cost control, forecasting, and overall financial performance. Partner Management: Experience developing and managing relationships with third-party or channel partners to enhance delivery capacity and capability. Customer Orientation: Proven ability to build trusted relationships with executive-level clients and drive customer success outcomes. Delivery Expertise: Deep understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) and enterprise solution delivery. Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate business goals into actionable delivery plans and scalable operational processes. Soft Skills: Exceptional executive-level communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; thrives in dynamic, customer-centric environments. Technical Acumen: Familiarity with system integrations, data migrations, and enterprise SaaS architectures. Data-Driven Management: Proficiency in interpreting delivery KPIs and using analytics to improve team performance and delivery quality. Ability to travel within Canada and to the US about 30%-40% Nice to Have Experience establishing or scaling a Professional Services practice or delivery center of excellence. PMP, CSM, or equivalent certification. Experience with change management and customer enablement programs. Prior experience managing multi-region or remote delivery teams. Strong understanding of implementation success metrics and how to operationalize them. What’s in it for you?🫵 We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! * 💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $124,000-$175,000 CAD based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰 Our compensation bands are based on various factors, including the labour market (as informed by our business stage and industry), job type and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further. Things to Note 📝 Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation. Travel - Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Questions? We are here to help If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to hr@claritisoftware.com and we’ll be happy to support you.

items.description: We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm Hello! We are GoFasti , a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe. We need an English-fluent Scheduler , based in Latin America, available to work remotely. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills. Are you the one we are looking for? Responsibilities: Create, assign, and manage all client visits in WellSky, including Start of Care (SOC), Recertification, Resumption of Care (ROC), Follow-Up, and Routine visits. Build and maintain accurate visit schedules for skilled nursing (RN/LPN), therapy (PT, OT, SLP), and aide staff. Enter and update visit authorizations based on payer source, including Medicare, Medicaid, private pay, and managed care plans. Process physician orders tied to visit frequency and duration within WellSky. Monitor the scheduling dashboard daily for unscheduled, missed, or conflicting visits. Coordinate with the clinical team to ensure visit frequency aligns with the Plan of Care (485). Match field clinicians and aides to clients based on availability, geographic location, skill set, and payer requirements. Maintain staff availability calendars, including PTO, call-outs, and schedule changes. Communicate schedule changes to clinicians, aides, and supervisors in a prompt and professional manner. Identify and fill coverage gaps to prevent missed visits and care disruptions. Maintain accurate employee profiles in WellSky, including credentials and authorized service types. Verify and track visit authorizations for all payers prior to scheduling any visit. Alert the billing and intake teams of authorization changes, expirations, or denials in a timely manner. Ensure all visits are scheduled within authorized units, service codes, and effective dates. Flag potential compliance issues including overlapping visits, duplicate billing risks, or frequency discrepancies. Serve as the primary point of contact for scheduling inquiries from clinicians, clients, and family members. Communicate daily with the clinical supervisor regarding visit coverage, staffing needs, and patient care priorities. Escalate urgent or clinical concerns to the appropriate supervisor immediately and without delay. Participate in daily or weekly scheduling huddles and interdisciplinary team meetings as required. Maintain accurate and up-to-date visit records in WellSky at all times. Run and review scheduling reports — including missed visits, visit utilization, and authorization utilization — and distribute findings to supervisors. Support the billing team by ensuring visit documentation is complete, accurate, and submitted in a timely manner. Assist with internal audits, external reviews, and compliance activities as needed. Requirements: High school diploma or GED required. Associate's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. 1 - 2 years of scheduling experience in a home health, hospice, or healthcare setting preferred. Prior experience with WellSky (formerly Kinnser) strongly preferred. Experience with managed care authorization processes preferred. Proficient in the WellSky EMR and scheduling platform. Strong organizational skills with the demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Excellent verbal and written communication skills across clinical and administrative settings. Ability to problem-solve quickly and adapt effectively to rapidly changing schedules and priorities. High attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record maintenance. Familiarity with home health regulations, payer requirements, and visit compliance standards. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, and Excel. It's a plus: Associate's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field. Prior experience with WellSky (formerly Kinnser). Experience with managed care authorization processes. Compensation: The salary range offered for this position varies from (USD) $1,000 - $1,500 per month, depending on seniority and skillset. This is a 40 hours per week. This position is for a full time contract, through a payroll platform. The talent will work remotely allocated at our client. Here are the steps for this process: Application review/approval > Screening interview with GoFasti's team > We build and send your profile to our client > Profile review/approval by client > Interview with the client > Hiring and onboarding. Once you apply for the job, our team will review your resume. If it meets the requirements, we will contact you and move forward in the process. Note for Candidates Approached Directly: If you were contacted directly by a member of our team and are interested in this opportunity, please do not apply through this link. Instead, reach out to the person who contacted you to coordinate a meeting. Thank you!

items.description: Intetics Inc. , a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our dynamic team on a part time basis. We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead digital and IT initiatives within a complex international environment, supporting large-scale technology programmes and collaborating with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries. We offer long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required (Germany). Requirements Master's degree or higher in Project Management, Business Administration, Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Extensive experience leading complex digital transformation programmes, enterprise IT initiatives, or portfolios of interconnected technology projects. Minimum 5 years of proven experience managing digital or IT-driven projects in structured enterprise environments. At least 5 years of experience overseeing project or programme financials, including budget planning, financial tracking, effort monitoring, cost control, and deliverable validation. At least 5 years of experience managing external vendors, technology partners, and service providers, including performance oversight and contractual accountability. At least 5 years of experience using structured project management and collaboration tools, such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent enterprise platforms. Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent projects or complex programmes involving cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance. Execute weekly release performance tests , analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness. Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates. Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes. Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data. Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines. Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings. Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles. Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency. Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript. Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues. Familiarity with Linux environments and basic command-line utilities. Understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with K6, Locust , or other modern performance testing frameworks. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, and basic cloud networking concepts. Basic understanding of Kubernetes and Docker , including containers, pods, deployments, and resource utilization. Experience with UI test automation using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing and development tools , including using generative AI to create test scripts, analyze results, troubleshoot failures, or improve automation efficiency. Basic knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts. Familiarity with Git commands and repository management , including branching, committing changes, creating merge requests, and resolving basic merge conflicts. Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar automation pipelines. Basic understanding of databases, SQL queries, and application architecture. Familiarity with distributed systems and microservices. What We’re Looking For A curious engineer who enjoys troubleshooting and understanding how systems behave under load. The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. items.description: About Valdera : At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly. Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you. Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together. Role Description: We are hiring a C hemical Data Scientist to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform. Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database. You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on. Role Responsibilities: Design and build pipelines to collect supplier data and chemical product information (specifications, CAS numbers, certifications, SDS/regulatory documents, NAICS classification of manufacturing plants) from supplier sites, distributor catalogs, trade databases, and other public and semi-structured sources Develop and maintain web scrapers and automated ETL workflows to keep supplier and product data current at scale Clean, normalize, and reconcile inconsistent supplier data into structured, standardized formats suitable for internal tools and analytics Apply chemical domain knowledge to validate and enrich data — resolving product names, CAS numbers, synonyms, and specifications across suppliers Evaluate and improve matching and classification models to map suppliers and products to buyer requirements, and to identify overlapping or equivalent chemical offerings Partner with Supplier Management and Engineering to define data quality standards, identify gaps in supplier coverage, and prioritize new data sources. Own pipeline health and data quality, and drive the KPIs that measure overall data coverage Experience & Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in a data science, data engineering, or applied data role, ideally with exposure to messy, real-world or industrial datasets. Working knowledge of chemistry or chemical industry data — comfort with CAS numbers, chemical properties, SDS documents, NAICS classification, and supplier certifications Strong Python skills, with experience building web scrapers and data pipelines Experience with data cleaning and normalization at scale, and a good eye for spotting inconsistencies in unstructured data Familiarity with building or applying matching, deduplication, or classification models (traditional ML or LLM-based approaches) Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to accelerate data extraction, enrichment, or engineering workflows Startup mindset with a strong sense of ownership — comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, remote environment with ambiguous, evolving priorities Compensation Additional Information Salary Range: Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role. Benefits: Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera. Equal Opportunity Employer Statement: Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

items.description: Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design. We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who loves building clean, performant interfaces and knows their way around a CMS well enough to make the backend work for the frontend, not against it. You'll spend most of your time in HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript — building custom Gutenberg blocks, theming, and pixel-perfect implementations from design mockups — while staying comfortable enough in PHP and WordPress/Drupal internals to troubleshoot, extend, and integrate when needed. You'll work directly with our design and consulting teams to turn mockups into fast, accessible, well-crafted websites for clients across a range of industries. What You'll Do Build custom WordPress themes, Gutenberg blocks (ACF or React-based), and plugins from provided designs Translate mockups into responsive, accessible frontend code using HTML, CSS/SASS, and modern JavaScript Work within Drupal for client sites that require it — theming, content types, and module-level troubleshooting Diagnose and fix frontend and backend issues across a variety of CMS platforms Collaborate directly with designers, consultants, and occasionally clients to solve problems and refine implementations Use AI tools like Claude Code to plan out and execute aspects of a large project. What You Bring Must-haves 5+ years of professional frontend development — strong HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript fundamentals 3+ years building and customizing WordPress sites, including Gutenberg block development (ACF or React-based blocks) Solid working knowledge of PHP (7.x/8.x) — enough to read, debug, and extend WordPress/Drupal codebases confidently Practical Drupal experience — theming, content architecture, or module-level work Familiarity with WordPress hooks/filters and general LAMP-stack conventions (MySQL, Git) Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating in a remote, client-facing environment Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude Code. Nice-to-haves Experience with React or Angular Laravel or Symfony Docker and Linux environment familiarity AWS or other cloud platform exposure Why Brafton 100% remote, full-time role with a US-based team lead and a genuinely collaborative, cross-office culture spanning five countries. Compensation Pay range displayed in CAD, plus commission Additional Information Benefits Include: Commission, Health Savings Account, pension, paid vacation, flexible remote schedule, and more!

items.summary: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference. By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future. Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies. items.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: We are seeking a dynamic Data Reports & Insights Analyst to join our Customer Success team. This role bridges the gap between data services and business intelligence. As a Reports & Insights Analyst, you'll help Cloudbeds customers turn raw operational and financial data into decisions they can act on. You'll build, analyze, and optimize reports across our PMS reporting suite, troubleshoot discrepancies before they become customer frustrations, and coach hoteliers on how to read metrics like ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, and channel performance with confidence. Every report you refine and every question you answer on calls or emails, directly shapes how hospitality businesses understand their own performance and grow their revenue. Our Team: Data Services sits at the intersection of hospitality expertise and reporting technology, working to make sure Cloudbeds customers never have to guess what their numbers mean. Reporting to your lead, you'll join a team that partners closely with Product, Onboarding, Support, and Customer Success to keep improving how customers access and interpret their data. It's a hands-on, collaborative group that treats every reporting question as a chance to make the platform and the customer's business a little smarter. What You Bring to the Team: You've spent time inside hotels and property management systems; you understand hospitality data isn't just numbers on a screen; it's occupancy, revenue, and guest behaviour telling a story. You're comfortable with advanced Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas) and have worked with BI or reporting tools involving dashboards, filters, and custom reports. You communicate clearly in written and verbal English, translating technical reporting concepts into plain language for customers who may not be data experts. You're detail-oriented, adaptable to shifting priorities, and genuinely enjoy solving the puzzle when a report doesn't add up. What Sets You Up for Success: Hospitality Tech Background: Direct experience working with Hotel Property Management Systems, channel managers and similar systems Client-Facing Expertise: A proven track record in onboarding, implementation, or Tier 2/3 technical support with a natural ability to teach and guide users. Advanced Spreadsheet Proficiency: Power-user skills in Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced formulas, and data cleaning). Analytical Mindset: Strong understanding of basic data management principles, data mapping, parsing, and root-cause error analysis. Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision when handling sensitive historical, financial, and guest records. Remote-First Readiness: Highly tech-savvy with cloud-based workflows and equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for video coaching sessions. Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional): Multilingual Capabilities: Professional proficiency (verbal and written) in Spanish or Portuguese. BI & Analytics Familiarity: Prior experience working with business intelligence dashboards or advanced financial reporting structures. What to Expect - Your Journey with Us Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary. Learn more online at cloudbeds.com Company Awards : Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025) Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025) Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024) Top 10 People’s Choice (2024) Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024) Discover our Benefits: Remote First, Remote Always PTO in accordance with local labor requirements Monthly Wellness Fridays - enjoy an extra-long weekend every month Fully Paid Parental Leave Home office stipend based on country of residency Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! items.description: What is PerfectServe? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! About the role Join a new, small team building PerfectServe's data platform. We are building the pipelines and models that bring data together from across PerfectServe's product portfolio. You will work closely with a staff data engineer and a platform engineer, with enough ownership to see your work in production and enough support to learn quickly. The source systems are varied, so the work spans extending established pipelines and designing new ones from scratch. That range is a good part of the job. Why this role, specifically Joining a platform in its first months is a different experience from joining one that is five years old. The patterns are still being set, which means your questions change them. You will see the whole path — a production source system at one end, someone making a decision at the other — rather than one layer of a stack somebody else assembled. You will have a dedicated team to work with and learn from so the ownership comes without being thrown in unsupported. What you will do Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from production source systems Write transformation models that turn raw data into datasets people can trust Apply dimensional and medallion modelling patterns as the warehouse takes shape Deploy pipelines to production, and test them properly — idempotency, data quality checks Contribute to data model and schema design, and to design reviews Document what you build, including runbooks for the pipelines you own What you bring Professional experience building data pipelines, with production ownership of at least some Strong SQL, and a working programming language — Python, Go or equivalent Hands-on dbt, or another transformation framework A cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or similar Practical ELT and orchestration experience (Fivetran, Airflow or equivalent) Working AWS knowledge — object storage, access basics, and enough networking to reason about where data moves A testing instinct for data, not only for code Nice to have Change-data-capture SQL Server sources Healthcare or another regulated data environment Exposure to a BI or semantic layer Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $115,000–$140,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

Be seen, be understood, be you. This role is responsible for the administration, analysis, and execution of global compensation, including salary structure, incentive plans, and annual compensation cycles. This role provides compensation analysis, job architecture governance, and supports compensation planning activities to ensure pay practices are competitive, equitable, and aligned with the organization’s compensation philosophy and frameworks. What you'll do Support the execution and administration of global compensation programs and annual compensation cycles, including merit planning, promotions, and bonus and incentive planning processes. Conduct compensation analysis, including pay equity reviews, market benchmarking, compa-ratio analysis, and compensation modeling to support informed compensation decisions. Review and validate compensation recommendations to ensure alignment with compensation philosophy, structures, internal equity, and budget parameters. Participate external compensation surveys, including job matching, data validation, submission, and interpretation of market results to inform compensation strategies. Support the development, maintenance, and governance of job architecture, including job structures, grades, leveling, and compensation frameworks. Prepare reports and dashboards compensation reports, modeling, and analysis to support annual compensation planning, bonus funding, workforce planning, and leadership decision-making. Ensure compensation data integrity and compliance with compensation policies, guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements. Identify trends, anomalies, and areas requiring review or escalation. Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance and business leaders to provide consultative compensation guidance and analysis. Perform other duties and responsibilities as required to support business needs. What you'll bring 5+ years of experience in compensation, total rewards, HR, finance, or a related analytical function. Experience working with compensation data, salary structures, incentive plans, or compensation planning processes. Experience working with spreadsheets and data analysis tools, including advanced spreadsheet functionality. Experience supporting compensation cycles such as merit increases, promotions, or bonus planning. Familiarity with compensation benchmarking and market data concepts. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills. Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Preferred Qualifications University degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience supporting global or multi-country compensation programs. Experience participating in compensation survey submissions and job matching (e.g., Radford, Mercer, Willis Towers Watson). Experience working with job architecture, salary grades, and compensation frameworks. Experience using HRIS and compensation planning tools (e.g., UKG, Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar systems). Experience supporting annual compensation planning cycles, including merit and bonus processes. Professional certification in compensation or human resources (e.g., CCP, GRP, PHR, or equivalent). Experience working in a fast-paced, data-driven, or global organization. Cision is the global leader in consumer and media intelligence, engagement, and communication solutions. We equip PR and corporate communications, marketing, and social media professionals with the tools they need to excel in today's data driven world. Our deep expertise, exclusive data partnerships, and award-winning products, including CisionOne , Brandwatch , and PR Newswire , enable over 75,000 companies and organizations, including 84% of the Fortune 500, to see and be seen, understand and be understood by the audiences that matter most to them. Cision is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and perform at their best. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion is vital to driving our culture, sparking innovation and achieving long-term success. Cision is proud to have joined more than 600 companies in signing the CEO Action for Diversity & Inclusion™ pledge and named a “Top Diversity Employer” for 2021 by DiversityJobs.com . Cision is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other protected statuses. Cision is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Cision will take the steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact hr.support@cision.com Cision, Inc. "the Company" only communicates with candidates and extends job offers through direct channels, not third parties. Please review our Global Candidate Data Privacy Statement to learn about Cision’s commitment to protecting personal data collected during the hiring process. For Individuals based in New York, Illinois, Colorado, Washington, and California, Cision is required to disclose a salary range for this role. This compensation range is specific to these states, however base pay may vary depending on a range of relevant factors. The base compensation for this role is $120,000 - $130,000 + bonus.

items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: • Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: • Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: • You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis , with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence (securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Headquarters: Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote) Who we are Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. About the role At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human. We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working. This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates. You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes. Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations. What you'll do Own and improve our IT operations Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution. Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems. Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management. Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience. Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects. Build smarter systems through AI and automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT. Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency. Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes. Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work. Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance. Think like a product owner Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements. Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact. Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs. Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience. Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning. Collaborate across Typeform Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues. Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members. Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation. What you'll bring Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company. ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management. Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations. Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian. Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools. Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity. Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management. Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution. A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Nice to have Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations. Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems. Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms. Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting. Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance. Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects. *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-senior-it-engineer

items.description: As a Future Tech Account Executive , you’ll be a trusted partner to mid-market and large enterprise customers, driving revenue growth and delivering innovative technology solutions. Leveraging your deep industry expertise and proven track record in selling advanced technology solutions—including PCs, storage, servers, networking, and other services —you will build and nurture strategic relationships, develop comprehensive sales plans, and consistently exceed results. In this role, you will identify new opportunities, expand existing accounts, and provide consultative expertise to help clients achieve their IT goals. With your ability to engage decision-makers at all levels and a strong network of industry relationships, you’ll thrive in shaping impactful solutions that align with customer objectives. This position has responsibilities that include working with government contractors; therefore, U.S. citizenship is required. This remote position will be based out of and work within NY/NJ Metro area. Our benefits include Medical, Dental and Vision insurance, 401k with company match, PTO. Responsibilities: Develop a deep understanding of customers’ business objectives, IT priorities, and solution requirements. Drive business growth by cultivating relationships with existing customers and establishing new partnerships through proactive engagement, including cold calling, customer meetings, and industry networking. Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise-level accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction and identifying opportunities to increase share of spend across our comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including data center, security, IT lifecycle services, hybrid cloud/ private cloud, and more. Build and execute strategic account plans, including sales forecasts and pipeline management, ensuring alignment across internal and external stakeholders. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, articulating total cost of ownership, market trends, and tailored solutions to meet their goals. Lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact, customized proposals and value-added solutions. Represent the company at industry events, building market awareness and strengthening customer and partner relationships. Continuously monitor competitive offerings and industry trends to effectively position the company’s value proposition and defend against competitors. Qualifications: 5+ years of sales experience, with a focus on enterprise accounts and demonstrated success working at a VAR or OEM . This position has responsibilities that include working with government contractors; therefore, U.S. citizenship is required. Proven ability to develop and execute account strategies, build sales forecasts, and lead cross-functional teams to meet or exceed sales targets. Strong network of industry relationships and ability to leverage them to drive new business. Expertise in supporting various stages of the sales lifecycle, including opportunity identification, qualification, proposal development, and contracting processes. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to consult effectively with C-level executives and decision-makers. Strong understanding of IT solutions and services, including hybrid cloud/ private cloud, data center, mobility, security, and IT asset lifecycle management. Commitment to ongoing education on industry trends, products, and competitive landscape. Why Join Future Tech Influence the future of a rapidly evolving enterprise technology leader. Collaborate with industry giants and public sector innovators to co-create impactful solutions. Enjoy a dynamic, entrepreneurial culture with a clear executive mandate for innovation. Competitive executive compensation and performance-based incentives. About Future Tech Enterprise, Inc. Future Tech Enterprise, Inc. is a recognized leader in delivering enterprise IT solutions and services to commercial, federal, and global clients. We are proud partners with technology innovators such as Dell Technologies, NVIDIA, Dell, Cisco, and others, helping our customers transform operations and drive digital modernization. #LI-Remote #FutureTechJobs Employment decisions at Future Tech Enterprise, Inc. will be based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community. We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone’s opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey. What we are looking for Senior Laravel & PHP Expertise: 5+ years of production experience with Laravel, including modern versions (Laravel 10–13) and PHP 8.3+. Core Framework Mastery: Deep command of Eloquent ORM (including query optimization and complex relationships), Laravel’s authentication/authorization ecosystem (Sanctum, Policies, Gates), queues, caching, and database architecture. Cloud & AWS Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and maintaining Laravel applications on AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS, ElastiCache, or Laravel Vapor), including managing CI/CD pipelines and production observability. Automated Testing Culture: Strong commitment to code quality with extensive experience writing unit, feature, and end-to-end tests using Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Playwright, or Laravel Dusk. API & Full-Stack Architecture: Proven track record designing and building resilient RESTful APIs (or JSON:API) alongside modern reactive frontends using Inertia.js, React, Vue.js, or Laravel Livewire. UI Craftsmanship (Bonus): Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and building accessible, responsive component libraries. Extreme Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your code—from architectural decisions and accurate estimation to deployment and production stability. Client-Centric Mindset: Ability to align closely with Bluelight’s clients’ business objectives, translating complex requirements into reliable, on-time deliverables. Collaborative & High-Bar Engineering: A proactive, solutions-oriented attitude paired with forensic attention to detail in code reviews, security, and edge-case handling. Company Benefits Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

items.description: About Boomi and What Makes Us Special Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity. Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more. Partner Sales Director, SLED (Hybrid PAM/PSM) How you’ll make an impact: As a Partner Sales Director covering State, Local, and Education (SLED) at Boomi, you will drive revenue by activating our integration partner ecosystem to win and expand public sector accounts in the US. You’ll manage existing SLED partners (PAM) while recruiting and developing new ones (PSM), using a strategic sales mindset to extend the reach of our SI, ISV, and resale partners into state agencies, counties, cities, school districts, and higher education. The ideal candidate brings vision, executive presence, and collaboration skills, plus enough integration partner experience to help direct sellers navigate public sector buying cycles. What you’ll do: Support Boomi’s SLED direct sales teams from a channel and alliances perspective, connecting Account Executives to the right partners for public sector opportunities. Manage a portfolio of SLED-focused partners, owning account plans, pipeline reviews, and partner performance targets. Recruit, onboard, and develop new partners with public sector practices, focusing on SIs and ISVs that serve state, local, and education customers. Cultivate executive-level relationships with partner leaders, leveraging their influence in key SLED accounts. Collaborate with partner leaders on joint GTM plans that accelerate public sector revenue and drive practice development and industry-specific POVs. Drive awareness and enablement of Boomi’s full platform with partners, including public sector use cases. Navigate cooperative purchasing contracts and procurement vehicles to help partners and sellers get to contract faster. Conduct regular cadences between partners and direct sellers to drive accountability and execution. Achieve and exceed performance targets with strategic SLED accounts and partners. Ensure effective and timely internal and external communication. The experience you bring: BA, BS, or related degree 8+ years in channel sales or channel management, including meaningful experience selling to state, local, or education customers Familiarity with public sector procurement: RFP/RFQ processes, budget cycles, and cooperative contracts (e.g., NASPO ValuePoint, Sourcewell, OMNIA) Knowledge of the iPaaS, integration, and API technology landscape Experience working with SIs, ISVs, resellers, and OEM partnerships Existing relationships with SLED-focused partners are a strong plus Willing and able to travel up to 50% Key competencies: Ability to develop and execute a comprehensive partner and account strategy across both existing and new partners Understanding of growing and sustaining a business in a competitive public sector market Ability to liaise with and motivate individuals at all levels of partner organizations Comfortable working with multiple teams and stakeholders, from individual contributors to senior executives, across internal and external teams Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The expected annual pay range for this position represents base salary or On-Target Earnings (OTE) for commission-based roles. Final compensation will be determined by various factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, geographic location, and role type. items.description: KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense. Position open to candidates located in Brazil . Please submit your resume in English. To learn more about our team and office culture in São Paulo, Brazil, visit the following links. Careers Page: https://www.knowbe4.com/careers/locations/sao-paulo Glassdoor : https://www.glassdoor.com/Location/KnowBe4-S%C3%A3o-Paulo-Location-EI_IE969384.0,7_IL[…]M_-C1lsxoZq7Cx8IriVE8MkrzuTmnJzqego77RAWZz9sqGt_55BflwYKpQeg LinkedIn : https://www.linkedin.com/company/knowbe4/life/brazil/ This is a Data Platform Engineering seat. Your mission is to build the tooling, infrastructure, and pipelines that allow engineering and product teams to self-serve while reliably delivering high-integrity data to customer-facing applications, internal reporting, ML models, and autonomous AI agents. You will join the core team behind our data platform: an event-driven lakehouse on AWS handling tens of thousands of events per second. You will design, build, and operate the near-real-time pipelines that model product and service events through medallion layers using open table formats and analytical engines, delivered as strictly tested, peer-reviewed, and version-controlled software. We build with agents, for agents: Our platform is itself agentic. We actively develop and maintain skills and AI agents that scaffold new pipelines, monitor upstream repositories and tickets for data-contract changes before they break downstream systems, autonomously triage alerts, and assist with cross-repo code reviews. Key Responsibilities Architect, deploy, and operate production near real-time streaming workloads on AWS from ingestion to analytical serving layers. Model complex event streams through bronze/silver/gold medallion architectures using modern open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg). Implement robust checkpointing, state recovery, schema evolution, and deduplication to safeguard against silent data corruption and ordering anomalies. Develop internal developer agents and automation loops (scaffolding, change detection, quality circuit breakers, and alert triage). Spot platform bottlenecks, architectural debt, or emerging technologies before anyone files a ticket—scope the solution and champion it to production. Requirements & Qualifications Experience owning production Spark streaming workloads, including orchestration, checkpointing, monitoring, alerting and failure recovery. Python you’d put your name on: tested, typed, reviewed and shipped through CI. AWS fluency and comfort reading and changing infrastructure as code. Hands-on experience with modern table formats, including upserts, schema evolution and the maintenance they need. Strong data modelling judgement, including knowing the tradeoffs and limits of a design. Experience with event-stream or CDC ingestion, and the de-duplication and ordering problems that come with it. The ability to take a vague stakeholder request, work out the real question, come back with a design, and explain the result and its caveats to people who don’t read code. The judgement to spot what the platform needs before anyone files a ticket, scope it and make the case for it, including new technologies where they would serve us better. A track record of raising the bar around you: reviewing, mentoring and setting conventions a team actually follows. Interest in or experience building, agentic tooling for engineering work itself: scaffolding, change detection, triage and review loops. Clear verbal and written English communication skills to collaborate effectively across international teams. Our Fantastic Benefits We offer company-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses - all in a modern, high-tech, and fun work environment. For more details about our benefits in each office location, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/benefits . Note: An applicant assessment and background check may be part of your hiring procedure. Individuals seeking employment at KnowBe4 are considered without prejudice to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/request-accommodation. No recruitment agencies, please.

Comfortable with marketing tools like Slack, Webflow, G2, Gartner, Plausible Analytics, Google ecosystem B2B Experience: Ideally some marketing experience in the B2B SaaS landscape.
