Let the right career opportunity find you and join us! How will you make an impact? As Operations Manager for the Integration and Delivery Tools platform at METRO, you will own the operational health of the integration landscape and delivery tooling that our business-critical journeys depend on. You will combine hands-on SRE depth with a quality mindset, to make the platform observable, resilient and cost-aware, and to turn incidents into lasting improvements across all squads. You will work half of your time hands-on and half coordinating squads, vendors and stakeholders. Please note that this role is open also for candidates in Brasov and Cluj. Job Description Your responsibilities Own the operational stability of the Integration and Delivery Tools platform across all squads, and act as the escalation point for platform-level incidents. Design, document and run the oncall and live-support model for the integration side, and take part in the oncall rotation yourself. Lead major incident calls and post-incident reviews; drive RCA, problem management and the closure of systemic remediation. Audit and improve monitoring and observability (Datadog), with clear ownership, meaningful alerts and reduced alert noise. Define and track SLAs, SLOs and platform KPIs, and use dashboards and trends to anticipate risks and steer improvements. Plan and run disaster recovery and resilience exercises, and close the gaps they reveal. Drive performance and resilience testing together with the squads, and apply quality gates for critical journeys and releases. Plan cloud capacity and seasonal readiness, and contribute to FinOps and cost optimisation of the platform. Coordinate squads, vendors and business stakeholders during escalations and outages, and keep incident hygiene and ticket quality high. Contribute to the platform operations strategy together with the Platform Lead and architects, and coach squads on an operations assurance mindset. Qualifications Required key competencies and qualifications At least 5 years of hands-on experience in operations, SRE or platform engineering, running production systems of large enterprise applications. At least 3 years of experience leading or coordinating teams, incident response or operational workstreams (line management is not required). Strong hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tooling, ideally Datadog, including alerting design and dashboards. Solid understanding of SRE principles: SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, incident, problem and change management. Experience with cloud environments and planning for capacity, resilience, disaster recovery and cost (FinOps). Practical experience in performance and resilience testing, or a background in QA or test leadership with a strong operations focus. Proven ability to define and implement operational processes (oncall, runbooks, RCA, post-incident reviews). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, able to investigate incidents across multiple data sources. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills for technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent English, written and verbal; based in Romania. Nice to have Familiarity with integration platforms, ideally MuleSoft, and API-based (Apigee) architectures. Experience with release governance and CI/CD pipelines. Experience in chaos or failover drills and seasonal peak readiness programs. Scripting and automation skills to reduce operational toil. Additional Information What we offer at METRO.digital? Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment. At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup. People development: when you grow so do we! We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation … it´s time to upskill your career. Support with individual solutions: We are people-caring! We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey. We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey. Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here. Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now! Position grade within our career framework: Operations Manager (Md8).

items.description: Hume AI is seeking talented AI researchers interested in working with our team to build state-of-the-art speech-language models (SLMs). Our new SLM training method—reinforcement learning from human expression (RLHE)—learns human preferences from behavior in millions of audio and video recordings, making SLMs superhumanly helpful, interesting, funny, eloquent, honest, and altruistic. Join us in the heart of New York City and contribute to our endeavor to ensure that AI is guided by human values, the most pivotal challenge (and opportunity) of the 21st century. About Us Hume AI is a Series B startup dedicated to building artificial intelligence that is directly optimized for human well-being. As the first company to release speech language models, we’re focused on expanding our research to encompass audio understanding models and evaluation platforms for enterprises. Our goal is to enable a future in which technology draws on an understanding of human emotional expression to better serve human goals. As part of our mission, we also conduct groundbreaking scientific research, publish in leading scientific journals like Nature , and support a non-profit, The Hume Initiative, that has released the first concrete ethical guidelines for empathic AI ( www.thehumeinitiative.org ). You can learn more about us on our website ( https://hume.ai/ ) and read about us in WIRED , Forbes , and Venturebeat . About the Role We are looking for talented researchers with relevant publications, 2+ years of experience in a research role in industry, and/or a proven track record of contributions to open source language, audio, or video models. (A PhD is neither necessary nor sufficient.) We're looking for someone excited to work with our team to build state-of-the-art audio models and evaluation tools. In this role, you will build out software systems that support distributed model training, inference, and benchmarking as well as massive-scale data collection, storage, preprocessing, and analysis. You will be working to solve some of today’s most exciting AI research problems at industry scale. Requirements Expertise in the Python ecosystem and popular ML libraries and tools (e.g. PyTorch) Experience writing robust and maintainable production-ready code Comfort iterating quickly on new and uncertain research directions 2+ years of experience contributing to the training and/or fine-tuning of models with large-scale datasets of text, audio, image, and/or video data (predictive or generative) Application Note Please apply only to the position that best aligns with your qualifications. If you submit multiple applications or have applied within the past 6 months, only your initial submission will be considered. Annual Salary $180,000—$350,000 USD

items.title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
items.summary: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build produc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager , you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation. You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market. What You’ll Do: Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality What We Look For: 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products. Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot. Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool. Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool). Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance. Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment. BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience. Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time. Nice to Have: Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics. Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment. Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs. Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization. What We Offer You: Competitive salary and stock option plan 100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance Flexible PTO Opportunities for professional growth and development Paid parental leave Health & wellness initiatives #BI-Hybrid #LI-Hybrid For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants. Environmental & Working Conditions Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. J ob duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-demand-generation-manager-auto

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. About the role: The Revenue Strategy & Growth Associate role is a generalist position at Clipboard, suited to an “all-around athlete” who can do it all and wants exposure to a range of problems and opportunities. You’re likely someone with an analytical mind who’s interested in and capable of solving different problem types. You’re a critical thinker, resourceful, adaptable and confident that you can figure it out if you can sink your teeth in deep enough. These are the ingredients for a problem solver who is eager to flex into multiple types of projects and responsibilities, depending on what’s needed and most impactful. You will: Own a project from framing through delivery, owning the analysis, recommendation, the rollout, and the outputs. Build systems and automations that improve how a workstream runs. Partner with cross functional teams to implement changes. Track and publicly report on the results of your work. What you bring: Solid analytical and modeling skills Project ownership. You can scope, sequence, and deliver without close oversight. Translate analysis into a recommendation. You don’t just stop at the chart. Strong, reliable communication. Experience 1-4 years in S&O, analytics, consulting, or a comparable analytical role. What We Offer Competitive base salary Insurance benefits and 401k options Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays Remote-first flexibility You can also get a sense of what it's like to work in the team by checking out this profile of Ryan . Quick Note on Scammers: Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here .

items.description: AE Studio builds products, platforms, and internal ventures that increase agency for all conscious beings. We combine world-class software engineering, AI expertise, and product design to ship ambitious projects that matter. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Data Scientist at AE Studio, you’ll work on a mix of client projects and internal research initiatives. You’ll solve real-world problems, help build meaningful products, and contribute to groundbreaking AI alignment research. Your work will involve building data-driven solutions, leveraging machine learning models, and using your creativity to deliver results that matter. In addition to client projects, you’ll have the opportunity to propose and pursue high-impact research projects , especially those aligned with our mission of increasing agency. Promising projects could even become prioritized skunkworks initiatives. We want problem-solvers who are adaptable, collaborative, and excited to push boundaries. If this sounds like you, let’s talk. ABOUT YOU You thrive on solving challenging problems and bring a mix of technical expertise, creativity, and humor to your work. You enjoy working independently but also love collaborating with a team that shares your passion for making a difference. Required Skills and Experience Fluency in Python .. Experience with LLM lifecycle: prompt design/engineering, prompting techniques (RAG, few-shot, CoT, etc.), vector databases, multimodality, fine-tuning, and evaluation. Proven data science experience : You’ve been a key contributor to impactful projects and know how to deliver results with real-life outcomes. Statistical & causal ML fundamentals: expertise in experimental design, uncertainty quantification, and rigorous model evaluation across tabular, time-series, and foundation-model fine-tuning tasks. Deep learning experience : Expertise in building/training NLP or computer vision models with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. Agile & AI-powered development: You run lean Kanban/Scrum cycles and leverage AI-powered tools like Cursor to prototype quickly and ship high-impact solutions. Growth mindset : You embrace challenges, value progress over perfection, and constantly seek to improve. Self-management : You can work independently, take ownership of projects, and deliver without constant oversight. Product and UX understanding : You care about delivering a seamless, user-friendly experience. Effective communication in English : Clear, concise, and maybe even witty communication is essential. Bonus Points for Self-managed projects : Ideally something that you helped develop from zero and shipped to real users. Startup experience : You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy taking on new challenges. Client relationship management : Experience managing clients and delivering excellent results. Passion for AI alignment : You care deeply about humanity’s future and want to help navigate the challenges of advancing AI. WHAT WE OFFER Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or join us in one of our offices. Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, not micromanagement. Competitive pay: Regular performance-based raises and a diversified employee equity program. Opportunities for growth: Work on cutting-edge R&D and propose projects that could become our next skunkworks focus. Supportive environment: A team that collaborates, mentors, and shares knowledge. Perks: Weekly knowledge-sharing talks, an annual team retreat, and much more. EQUITY Working at AE means receiving equity in our client projects and in Skunkworks ventures. The equity is priced at $0 when granted for tax reasons, but AE invests millions into these projects. Equity comes from reduced margins on client work and internal funding. You get a real stake in the things you help build. The longer you stay, the more value you create and the more equity you receive. If you leave on good terms, you can retain 20% of your equity by staying engaged. If you spin out a Skunkworks venture, you retain 100%.

items.summary: About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality.
items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity centers on thorough nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release qualifications using Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). Scope of Work Manually analyze and interpret TEM and SEM micrographs for nanoparticle sizing and morphological assessment Determine and document particle size distributions (PSD) with rigorous attention to accuracy and reproducibility Establish and communicate lot-release acceptance criteria based on technical reference cases and quality control standards Prepare detailed reports summarizing findings, methodologies, and recommendations for material qualification Validate measurement techniques through manual calibration, thresholding, and cross-checking against reference data Participate in technical discussions, providing expert insights on nanomaterial characterization and quality control criteria Deliver clear, concise written and verbal communications to facilitate knowledge transfer across project teams Preferred Qualifications Advanced knowledge of nanomaterial characterization, especially using TEM and SEM Demonstrated hands-on experience in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation Proficiency with manual image analysis, including thresholding, calibration, and interpretation of complex morphologies Strong understanding of quality control standards and reference material qualification protocols Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration Ability to evaluate and validate technical reference cases without the use of AI-based tools Background in scientific consulting, materials science, or laboratory-based analytical roles is a plus Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of analyzing financial markets, interpreting investment strategies, and supporting decision-making across asset classes. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve financial literacy, strengthen portfolio analysis, and support investors and analysts worldwide. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as equity and fixed-income markets, portfolio management, asset allocation, derivatives, valuation methods, financial modeling, risk management, behavioral finance, and macroeconomic influences on markets. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as fundamental and technical analysis, portfolio construction, diversification strategies, market cycles, performance evaluation, and investment research—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and analytical accuracy. On a typical day, you will engage the model with investment scenarios, analytical questions, and market-based reasoning tasks; verify factual correctness and financial logic; assess the validity of investment reasoning; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and analytical depth. You may also help identify where models oversimplify market behavior or misinterpret financial data. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience in asset management, brokerage, research, financial planning, or related roles is valuable, and entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of investments and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of investments into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support investors, analysts, and financial professionals worldwide. We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Culver City, California, United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/kZSiaRVHB45MDzQ7znFJSV/jobs-at-crazy-maple-studio Crazy Maple Studio is a fast-growing company based in the Bay Area and Los Angeles, focusing on mobile gaming, reading, and streaming. We are proud to have a global team that drives our innovation and success across diverse markets. Our flagship platform, ReelShort, is the #1 vertical streaming app in the U.S., with over 8 million DAU, delivering bite-sized episodic content that keeps viewers hooked. Other standout products include Chapters, where users shape immersive stories across drama, fantasy, and romance, and My Fiction, a platform for consuming and creating serialized romance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of the Global Most Loved Workplaces 2025, reflecting our commitment to innovation, creativity, and an employee-first culture. Position Overview: As an AI-Assisted Story Writer, you will create short, high-hook, pay-per-chapter stories for mobile readers, working hand in hand with external AI and our in-house AI story system. Our system guides every story through a proven pipeline; your job is to steer that process with strong editorial judgment, push every story past "good enough," and turn out titles that readers pay to finish. This is an ROI-driven role. Every story you deliver goes into live testing, and its results (ad performance, reader conversion past the paywall, and return on ad spend) are the main measure of your success. The ideal candidate is a commercial storyteller first: someone who instinctively understands hooks, cliffhangers, revenge payoffs, romance tension, and why a reader taps "unlock" on the next chapter. You are comfortable using AI as a creative partner, you know when to trust it and when to override it, and you are energized rather than intimidated by data. Key Responsibilities: Use AI story system to write complete short stories of roughly 20,000 words, from title and logline through final chapter, delivered on schedule. Develop stories from a wide range of source material, including one-line ideas, trending topics, web novels, user-generated content, and existing hit stories. Approve story direction at each checkpoint: genre track, core reader expectation, paywall placement, and chapter-by-chapter emotional pacing. Edit and polish AI drafts so the final prose is vivid, emotionally specific, consistent in voice, and free of generic or repetitive AI patterns. Write high-impact titles, loglines, opening hooks, and paywall moments designed to drive ad clicks and reader conversion. Review testing results for every story you deliver, utilize retest reports to diagnose what underperformed, and revise promising stories that fall short of targets. Track your own story performance and apply what you learn to each new title. Stay current on trending tropes, hit stories, and reader tastes across short fiction, web novels, and short-form video drama, and bring new story ideas to the team. How Success Is Measured: Test pass rate: the share of your stories that meet or beat performance benchmarks in live testing. Return on ad spend (ROAS): how efficiently your stories turn marketing spend into reader revenue. Reader conversion: how well your opening and paywall turn readers into paying readers. Output and turnaround: consistently delivering finished, test-ready stories on schedule. Revision impact: how much your rewrites improve the results of underperforming stories. Minimum of 2 years of writing experience in commercial fiction, such as serialized fiction, web novels, Wattpad, Kindle Vella, romance publishing, short drama scripts, or a similar medium. A portfolio that shows strong commercial instincts: fast-paced plotting, emotional payoffs, and hooks that keep readers turning pages. Strong command of romance, revenge, family drama, and suspense, including popular tropes and what readers expect from them. Hands-on experience using AI writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a real writing workflow. Excellent editing skills and the judgment to spot and fix flat, clichéd, or illogical AI output. Comfort with a results-driven environment where performance data shapes priorities and compensation. Ability to read and act on basic performance metrics (click-through rate, conversion, ROAS). Comfortable writing young adult and adult romance and drama, which may include sensitive and triggering content. Native or near-native English writing ability for English-speaking Western readers. Strong attention to detail, self-direction, and the ability to manage multiple stories at once under deadline. Flexibility to work across different time zones and communicate clearly in a remote team. Eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Nice to Have: Experience writing for pay-per-chapter apps or short-form video drama platforms. A track record of stories or titles with measurable commercial results (reads, rankings, sales, or conversion). Experience writing ad copy, hooks, or marketing content for fiction. Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Compensation: $3,000. This is an independent contractor (1099) position with an initial one-month term. Sales & Market Support Schedule and coordinate qualified meetings between prospective partners and the wider sales team. Support preparation for prospect meetings and presentations by gathering relevant company, market and performance information. Track outreach activity, meetings, pipeline progress and conversion in Salesforce. Share recurring prospect feedback, local-market insights and emerging opportunities with regional stakeholders. Support relevant industry events, networking opportunities and partner engagement initiatives. About You Ideally 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, sales development, business development, partnerships or another client-facing commercial role. Fluent Japanese with strong written and verbal communication skills, alongside professional working English. Strong understanding of Japanese business culture and the confidence to engage professionally with local stakeholders. Curious about technology, apps, gaming, digital advertising and the wider publisher ecosystem. Strong research skills with the ability to identify promising businesses and assess commercial opportunities. Confident starting conversations with prospective clients and developing relationships over time. Comfortable working with data and using simple insights to support outreach and commercial conversations. Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple prospects, follow-ups and priorities. Proactive, self-motivated and eager to learn. Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is useful. Previous experience within technology, apps, gaming, AdTech, media or digital businesses is valuable but not essential. When you share your details with us, we consider this as consent for us to use your data during the application process. We may implement AI in various stages of the recruitment process, but human involvement will always remain as part of our hiring ethos. At the moment, MASH is not in a position to sponsor work visas, so you have to be eligible to legally work in the country where we’re hiring. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Karnataka, India URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app Role - Video Editor Work Location - Work From Home About Lokal : In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal) Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app) Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze) Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital About the role : We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact. Key Responsibilities: ● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers. ● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention. ● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts). ● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design. ● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life. ● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable. ● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates. ● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Albania URL: http://pavago.co Description SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies. You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) . Key Responsibilities SEO Strategy & Optimization Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic. Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis. Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance. Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data. Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates. Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO). Paid Advertising & Lead Generation Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads . Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels. Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns. Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals. Content Marketing & Website Management Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives. Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages. Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms . Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager . Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports. Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns. Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates. Marketing Automation & CRM Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows. Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign . Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs. Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing. Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation. Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization . Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines. Availability during U.S. Business Hours . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting. Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results. You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together. You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance. You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements. You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams. What a Typical Day Looks Like Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability. Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance. Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results. Interview Process Initial Application Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview Recruiter Screening Client Interview Final Selection & Onboarding Spark Hire Video Interview – Required As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire . After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses. Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation. Apply Now If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you. Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results. #SEOSpecialist #DigitalMarketing #TechnicalSEO #GoogleAds #PerformanceMarketing #LeadGeneration #AEO #GEO #MarketingAutomation #RemoteMarketingJobs #RemoteJobs #LI-AG1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pavago-seo-digital-marketing-specialist

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: CINEMATIC VIDEO EDITOR – REAL ESTATE & CONSTRUCTION Salary range: up to Php 88,000 Philippine Peso/month (The final amount will be at the the client discretion basing on the candidate’s skills and experience.) Working Hours: Monday to Friday following New Zealand business time Work set-up: 100% Remote work (Independent Contractor Agreement) Holidays: TBC Recruitment process: possible multiple client interviews and assessment About the Company & Role Our client is a creative media production company specialising in producing professional visual content for businesses within the property, building, and construction sectors. The company provides a range of creative services, including photography, videography, aerial footage, and digital content production, helping businesses showcase their properties, projects, and services through compelling visual presentations. They are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Video Editor who can transform raw footage into polished, cinematic, and engaging video content that captures the quality and appeal of each project. The role involves editing various types of footage, including property walkthroughs, architectural spaces, construction developments, and commercial project showcases, while maintaining a consistent and professional visual style. The successful candidate will be expected to produce approximately 2–3 completed videos daily, balancing creative execution, technical quality, and production efficiency. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced editor who enjoys visual storytelling, understands cinematic editing techniques, and can deliver high-quality content in a fast-paced creative environment. Key Responsibilities Video Editing & Post-Production Edit raw video footage into professional, engaging, and cinematic video productions. Produce approximately 2–3 completed videos per day while maintaining consistent quality and creative standards. Create property walkthroughs, real estate promotional videos, architectural showcases, and construction project features. Apply professional editing techniques, including sequencing, transitions, pacing, music integration, and visual storytelling. Perform colour correction and colour grading to achieve a polished and consistent cinematic look. Edit and incorporate drone footage, interior and exterior shots, and other visual assets into cohesive video presentations. Adapt editing styles based on project requirements, target audiences, and creative direction. AI-Assisted Editing & Content Production Utilise AI-powered video editing and enhancement tools, particularly Higgsfield, to improve production workflows and creative output. Apply AI-assisted effects, enhancements, and visual elements while ensuring the authenticity and quality of the final content. Produce videos in different formats and aspect ratios, including landscape and vertical formats for various digital platforms. Optimise video content for online marketing and social media distribution. Ensure proper audio synchronisation, sound quality, captions, and overall video presentation. Quality Control & Project Management Review all completed videos to ensure accuracy, consistency, and professional production standards before delivery. Manage multiple editing assignments and consistently meet daily production targets and deadlines. Maintain organised project files, raw footage, editing assets, and completed outputs. Implement feedback and revision requests promptly while maintaining attention to detail. Identify opportunities to improve editing workflows, turnaround times, and production efficiency. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Maintain consistency with the company's established creative direction and visual standards. Lead the full sales cycle—from account targeting, prospecting, and lead generation to RFP responses, executive presentations, conference engagement, negotiations, and closing. Unlock expansion. Partner with Strategic Account Management (SAM) and Alliance Delivery Leads (ADLs) to identify upsell opportunities, grow existing relationships, and support successful implementation. Structure deals that win. Work with Legal, Finance, and the Pricing Committee to develop competitive proposals, establish payer-specific pricing, and negotiate contracts that deliver value for customers and Omada. Make the value clear. Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Clinical, and Data teams to translate Omada’s clinical and economic outcomes into compelling value propositions, value-on-investment (VOI) proof points, and performance guarantees. Bring the market inside. Turn customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and payer trends into actionable insights that sharpen our positioning and inform product innovation. Drive disciplined execution. Maintain an accurate pipeline, establish clear next steps, and deliver reliable forecasts that support accountability and results. Candidate Profile You know how to win complex payer business—and you have the results to prove it. A track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas by selling complex solutions to health plans and PBMs. Established payer relationships and a clear understanding of how health plans and PBMs evaluate, purchase, and implement digital health solutions, medical services, and clinical programs. 6+ years experience securing new business and expanding partnerships through direct contracts (10+ preferred). The ability to navigate long sales cycles, align multiple decision-makers, and maintain momentum through complex buying processes. Strong command of deal structuring, pricing strategy, contract negotiation, and implementation requirements. Executive presence and the ability to build trust, challenge assumptions constructively, and connect solutions to customer priorities. Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the agility to tailor your message and respond confidently in high-stakes discussions. An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, quick to adapt, and resourceful in solving problems. A collaborative approach that brings teams together around a clear strategy and shared results. Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Benefits Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus Stock options Remote first work from home culture Flexible vacation to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones Generous parental leave Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions) 401k retirement savings plan Work from Home stipend Monthly mental wellness days Two giftable Omada enrollments per calendar year …and more! It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada! Start with Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other. Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road. Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers. Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work. Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together. Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it. Working with over 1,700+ customers — including health plans, health systems, and employers ranging in size from small businesses to Fortune 500s across a wide variety of industries — Omada delivers personalized interventions for diabetes, diabetes prevention, hypertension, and musculoskeletal issues. All programs include integrated behavioral health support. Omada Health’s virtual care programs are clinically supported and evidence-based, with results published in multiple peer-reviewed journals. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes. We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer. What You'll Do: Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it What You'll Bring: 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable This Role is a Great Fit If: You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: CA - San Francisco HQ; CA-Remote Employee Applicant Privacy Notice Who we are: Shape a brighter financial future with us. Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world. The role: SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative. At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you. What you’ll do: This role owns four core areas of responsibility: 1. Creative Strategy & Planning Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives. Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager. Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief. Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action. 2. Campaign & Production Management Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors. Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders. Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements. Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable. Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates. Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time. Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details. Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop. Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up. 3. Compliance, Quality & Operations Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements. Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files. Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready. Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget. 4. Performance, Insights & Competitive Intelligence Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals. Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies. Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders. Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap. Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies. Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy. What you’ll need: Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives. Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry. Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously. Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows. Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management. Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors. Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact. Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions. Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution. Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications.
